quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right and then left.
The road curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about dangers ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right and then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic must go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic must go in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
You may go if the way is clear.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong direction and risk a head-on crash. You should turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to keep to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge onto your road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane must turn left.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider points their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed in a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey these signs. This sign means passing other vehicles is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet, making your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign tells you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The highest safe speed when road and weather conditions are good.
The highest safe speed in all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed when road and weather conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit. In bad conditions, always slow down.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a law sign that drivers must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop completely, then go when safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is extra slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road. Watch for people in the crosswalk. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction of a sharp curve. The road curves sharply to the left. Multiple signs may be placed along the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road is joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road has many curves ahead. Slow down.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Look for pedestrians and other vehicles. Wait until the intersection is clear before moving forward.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid crashes.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and look for pedestrians and other traffic. Give them the right-of-way. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If your left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means you are turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points their index finger, it tells the group to form a single line.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or guardrail between them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge into traffic. Slow down to 35 mph.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right. You should slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.
Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
Go slowly through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if another car is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop. You can only go forward after the stop when you know it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turn lane goes both ways.

questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must or must not do. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: This sign shows a type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T-shaped intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols or words. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards or special road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter this road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end soon. Drivers in the right lane need to move into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. If you bend your left arm at the elbow and point it upward, it means you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any vehicles or pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Get ready to stop completely before going forward.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when turn signals are not available. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out with their palm facing down and swings it down to their side, it signals riders behind them to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light, slow for a yellow light, or watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down above a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets or expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets or expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road has one-way traffic. Do not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: This shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped warning sign like this only means no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points downward, it signals they are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it tells other riders to go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, do not brake or turn suddenly, and keep more distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in this work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or steep downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be careful because wet conditions make the road slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the rules you must follow. This sign shows the direction traffic must move on that street.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: At a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic pass before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means low clearance is coming.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: If there are two or more lanes and it is safe, move over to make room for entering vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is controlling traffic ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at exactly the speed shown.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive. In bad weather or poor conditions, drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The bridge or overpass ahead is low.
Two lanes of traffic going opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge or overpass ahead is low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can either continue on the freeway or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leads off the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: When a motorcycle rider's left arm is extended straight out, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the rider will turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and give others the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and give others the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and give others the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down at the intersection, be ready to stop, and let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has a series of curves and turns ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a side road is ahead. Be aware that traffic may enter from the side road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. There is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. It warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Drive carefully where pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a minimum number of occupants.
Certain lanes allow specific turning movements only.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly together.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a minimum number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. This lane is reserved for buses and vehicles with the driver and one or more passengers as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple occupants.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disability permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Come to a complete stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn right or go straight.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you may either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What should concern you most when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and let other traffic pass. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has construction or maintenance work.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has construction or maintenance work.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction or maintenance ahead. Slow down and drive carefully in these areas.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may scrape or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Be careful in this area because bicycles often cross or travel near traffic here.
